ja.summary: TGS2026の現地体験版で『Weeping Light』をプレイする前は、少女たちが“罪”を背負い戦い続ける『不思議の国のアリス』にインスパイアされたゲームが、最終的にゲームプレイの核となる“ポーカー”デザインに陥るとは想像もしていませんでした。ローグライク、ACT 要素、ポーカー カードの構築が組み合わさって、「Weeping Light」という非常にユニークなゲームプレイ リズムを形成しています。プレイヤーは常に目の前に迫ってくる敵に対処しなければなりませんが、同時に、手の中のカードをどのように組み合わせて形成するかに注意を払う必要があります。たった30分ほどの試遊の中で、次の建築を考えながら戦っていくという体験は、今までにない楽しさを感じさせてくれました。体験版の概要 「Crying Light」の戦闘システムは複雑ではありませんが、一度始めてみると、「上手にプレイする」だけで体験できるアクションゲームではないことがわかります。プレイヤーは記憶を失い監禁された少女「アリス」を操作します。

en.title: When the sins girls bear become the strength for them to continue fighting: Exclusive interview with the producer of "Crying Light"
en.summary: Before playing "Weeping Light" in the on-site trial at TGS2026, I never thought that a game inspired by "Alice in Wonderland" that allows girls to bear "sins" and constantly fight would eventually fall into the "poker" design as its core gameplay. Roguelike, ACT elements and poker card construction together form a very unique gameplay rhythm of "Weeping Light" - players have to deal with the enemies approaching constantly in front of them, while at the same time they have to pay attention to how the cards in their hands should be combined and shaped. In just thirty minutes of trial play, this experience of fighting and thinking about the next step of construction really made me feel some fun that I had never expected before. Trial Summary The combat system of "Crying Light" is not complicated, but once you get started, you will find that it is not an action game that only relies on "playing well" to support the experience. The player controls "Alice", a girl who has lost her memory and is imprisoned.

items.summary: 久等了！《上海谍战风云录》主题曲《灯下无名》正式上线。由衷感谢作曲的鼓润老师，作词的邹佩君老师。是两位老师，帮我把那些鲜活却沉默的人和事，谱写成看得见雨雾、听得见江潮的旋律，让尘封的往事拥有声音的载体。在写播客文稿的时候，我总在想象三十年代真实的上海。不是荧幕上那个浮华的十里洋场，而是石库门的雨夜，苏州河的烟波，黄浦江奔涌的浪潮，是潮湿弄堂之中，一次次街头擦肩便赌上性命的普通人。歌词落笔的每一处，都是地下工作者曾经浴火坚守的土地 ——“擦肩那一刻，没有回望，人海茫茫中各自远航。”献给所有隐于灯下、无名前行的革命者。尽管硝烟远去，但这座城市的风雨江潮，会永远记得他们。

ja.title: 上海スパイゲームテーマソング丨Unknown Under the Light
ja.summary: 長い間お待ちください！ 『上海スパイクロニクルズ』のテーマソング「Unknown Under the Light」が正式リリース。作曲のGurunさん、作詞のZou Peijunさんに心より感謝いたします。生き生きとしていても物言わぬ人や物を、雨や霧の中に見えたり、川の潮の中で聞こえるようなメロディーに仕上げるのを手伝ってくれたのは二人の先生でした。そうすることで、埃っぽい過去が音を運ぶのです。ポッドキャストの脚本を書くとき、私はいつも 1930 年代の現実の上海を想像していました。それはスクリーンに映るきらびやかな10マイルの外国市場ではなく、石庫門の雨の夜、蘇州河の霧、黄浦江の荒波です。湿気の多い路地で、道ですれ違うたびに命の危険を冒しているのは、一般の人々です。歌詞が書かれている場所はどこでも、かつて地下労働者が火事の中でしっかりと立っていた土地です。「肩をすくった瞬間、振り返ることはできず、私たちはそれぞれ広大な人々の海を航海しました。」光の下に隠れ、匿名で前進するすべての革命家に捧げます。銃声は消え去ったが、この街の栄枯盛衰はいつまでも記憶に残るだろう。

en.title: Shanghai Spy Game Theme Song丨Unknown Under the Light
en.summary: Long wait! The theme song of "Shanghai Spy Chronicles" "Unknown Under the Light" is officially released. My heartfelt thanks to Mr. Gurun who composed the music and Mr. Zou Peijun who wrote the lyrics. It was two teachers who helped me compose those vivid but silent people and things into melodies that can be seen in the rain and mist, and heard in the river tide, so that the dusty past has a carrier of sound. When writing the script for the podcast, I always imagined the real Shanghai in the 1930s. It’s not the glitzy ten-mile foreign market on the screen, but the rainy night in Shikumen, the mist of the Suzhou River, the rushing waves of the Huangpu River. It’s the ordinary people in the damp alleys who risk their lives every time they pass each other on the street. Everywhere the lyrics are written is the land that underground workers once stood firm in the fire - "The moment we brushed shoulders, there was no looking back, and we each sailed away in the vast sea of ​​people." Dedicated to all revolutionaries who hide under the lights and move forward anonymously. Although the smoke of gunfire has faded away, the ups and downs of this city will always remember them.

en.summary: Note: This article will involve the core plot description of version 3.7. It is recommended to read this article after completing the game. After completing the main storyline of version 3.7 of "Ming Chao" "Meng Shu's Heart-to-Heart", I didn't rush to leave Xuanfang City, but went back to the city again. At this time, the Chaoyue Festival has become lively, with lights on both sides of the street, bustling crowds chatting lively, and fireworks blooming in the night sky. From 3.5 to 3.7, "Ming Tide" used three versions, laying out the past, present and future of Xuanfang land in front of players bit by bit. Until the final chapter, the story finally no longer revolves around the name that has always existed behind all legends - Xinyue Fox. This character who once only existed in the legend of Suizhu finally lost his distant sense of mystery and remained in the story of the Wanderer. When the "heart", Xinyue Fox, and everything that had happened in Xuanfang City in the past two hundred years were gradually put together, I realized that I had walked all the way.

en.title: Why do we still need an “offline figure party” with 150,000 people?
en.summary: Author: Bai Yazhou During the National Day of the past three years, I have to go to Shanghai to go to a somewhat special exhibition. From October 3rd to 4th, the 2026 Bilibili Shanghai International Figure Model Culture Expo (hereinafter referred to as "WF2026") kicked off here as scheduled. Following the crowds pouring into the venue, you will find a phenomenon that is rarely seen in other exhibitions: among the 150,000 or so offline attendees, you can see everywhere dragging huge hard-shell suitcases, folding trolleys with reinforced straps, and even young people carrying professional shock-proof photography bags. If you don’t know the modeling circle, you might think that these people are moving in this huge exhibition hall. But if you are a senior glue guy, a prototype artist, or someone who simply has a preference for the materialization of two-dimensional characters, you will understand it clearly - those boxes are filled with the purpose of properly protecting fragile, delicate, three-dimensional art that often takes months of hard work to create.

The real-time strategy type "StarCraft 2" was launched in 2003 and was not released until 2010. DLC updates will be stopped in 2020. items.title: 爆増する不正侵入と個人情報流出の恐るべき全自動手口、自律型AIエージェントが1件あたり激安4000円台で数百のオンラインサイトを延々と攻撃し続けている戦慄の実態が白日の下に
items.summary: タイムズカーやGMO、焼肉きんぐなど、2026年9月以降に日本の企業が不正アクセスによってユーザーの個人情報を流出させるインシデントが相次いで発生しており、AIの悪用が急速に進んでいるのではないかといわれています。セキュリティ企業のGambit Securityがある攻撃者の中継サーバーを入手して調査したところ、「Hermes」「Strix」「Cairn」という3種類のオープンソースAIツールが攻撃に使われていたことが分かりました。これらは人間に攻撃方法を提案するだけでなく、脆弱(ぜいじゃく)性の探索から侵入、権限の拡大、機密情報の探索、データの持ち出しまで攻撃の大部分を自律的に進めていたとさ

zh.title: 欺诈性入侵呈爆炸式增长，全自动的个人信息泄露方式令人恐惧，其中自主人工智能代理以每次攻击 4,000 日元的折扣无休止地攻击数百个在线网站，这一可怕的现实已经浮出水面。
zh.summary: 自2026年9月开始，时代汽车、GMO、烤肉王等日本企业已发生多起未经授权访问泄露用户个人信息的事件，据说AI的滥用正在迅速发展。安全公司Gambit Security获得了攻击者的中继服务器并进行了调查，发现攻击中使用了三种开源AI工具：“Hermes”、“Strix”和“Cairn”。这些设备不仅向人类建议攻击方法，而且能够自主执行大部分攻击，从搜索漏洞到渗透、扩大权限、搜索机密信息和泄露数据。

en.title: The horrifying reality of the explosive increase in fraudulent intrusions and terrifying fully automatic methods of personal information leakage, in which autonomous AI agents continue to attack hundreds of online sites endlessly at a discount of 4,000 yen per attack, has come to light.
en.summary: There have been a number of incidents in which Japanese companies leaked users' personal information through unauthorized access starting in September 2026, including Times Car, GMO, and Yakiniku King, and it is said that the misuse of AI is rapidly progressing. Security company Gambit Security obtained an attacker's relay server and investigated it, and found that three types of open source AI tools were used in the attack: ``Hermes,'' ``Strix,'' and ``Cairn.'' These devices not only suggest attack methods to humans, but also carry out most of the attack autonomously, from searching for vulnerabilities to infiltration, expanding privileges, searching for confidential information, and exfiltrating data.
